newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Bank Queensland sees improved new lending.
newsitem.headline: Bank Queensland sees improved new lending.

text.p: Bank of Queensland Ltd said on Friday there was evidence of a significant turnaround in new lending approvals in the current half year.
Bank of Queensland earlier announced a 21.7 percent fall in net profit for the six months to February 28.
"There is evidence of a signficant turnaround in new lending approvals," chairman Neil Roberts said in a statement.
"This upward trend has continued into the current half," Roberts said.
He said total approvals in March 1997 were 49.7 percent above the year ago level.
